rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2AA grading and gives a plausible blastocyst description, but it overstates image-confirmable details (e.g., debris/granularity, defined epithelial ring, subtle imperfections) and uses imprecise wording around expansion stage.

Integrates most relevant factors well, including age, PCOS, prior biochemical pregnancy, endometrium, oocyte yield, BMI, and sperm parameters, though some links are somewhat speculative and AMH is unavailable.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates broadly matching the case profile, but some adjustments are subjective and a few causal claims are not strongly supported.

Much of the assessment is broadly IVF-consistent, but several recommendations are not guideline-based or are controversial for this scenario (routine aspirin, thrombophilia workup after one biochemical pregnancy, ERA/NK-cell testing, MTHFR inclusion, endometrial scratching consideration).

Provides clear practical steps for luteal support, monitoring, lifestyle modification, and contingency planning, though some suggested interventions may be overly aggressive or insufficiently evidence-based.
